as_of_time_sole_authority.claim: as_of_time is always materialize_rolling_xg's available_at, on both the write path and the repair path.
evidence: src/w2/features/xg_materialization.py:materialize_rolling_xg has exactly one call site, src/w2/ingestion/xg_backfill.py:698, and it is what computes as_of_time. The two sites that construct TeamXgRollingSnapshotModel -- src/w2/ingestion/future_refresh_repository.py:2886 (upsert of supplied rows) and src/w2/ingestion/xg_retention.py:427 (repair from the rebuilt plan) -- both persist rows whose as_of_time came from that computation; neither derives one of its own.

src/w2/ingestion/xg_retention.py repairs as_of_time only from build_saved_raw_plan (xg_backfill.py:426), which rebuilds snapshots through the same materialize_rolling_xg, and _guarded_timestamp_updates restricts the repair to that one field.
src/w2/normalization/api_football.py:89 writes as_of_time on a FeatureSnapshot, a different type, and never on a rolling xG snapshot.
as_of_time_sole_authority.why_it_matters: A repair path that recomputed as_of_time some other way could silently substitute a kickoff-derived time for a component-availability one.

F6_H2H.reads: goals for and against in every prior meeting
F6_H2H.evidence_time_proof: src/w2/factor_model/remediation.py:_seed_history captures a fixtures response, records its capture with provider_captured_at = response.captured_at (via endpoint_capture_contract), then binds every FINISHED fixture item in that payload to that capture_id and passes the mapping to _upsert_history_fixtures. The history row therefore points at the very provider read whose payload already reported the result as finished, which is a real observation time for that result.

rejected_alternative.reason: _upsert_history_fixtures sets it to FactorModelRemediation.now -- the clock at the start of the materialisation run, which is earlier than the provider read it points at. Using it would claim the result was knowable before it was.

fail_closed_when: provider_captured_at is at or before the fixture kickoff
F6_H2H.consumed_set_cross_check: row count equals the contribution's meeting_count

F5_RECENT_AH_COVER.reads: settled Asian-handicap outcomes of prior matches
required_but_missing: the time the result of each consumed history match became available
the time the canonical AH quote or settlement fact became available

blocking_evidence.detail: src/w2/features/team_factors.py:_canonical_ah_rows admits a row only when source == 'canonical_historical_ah_fact', source_group == 'canonical_historical_ah_fact' and collection_status == 'CANONICAL_AH_FACT'. src/w2/prematch/analysis_calculator.py:_fixture_source_group looks for the same three markers in items read from runtime/independent_signal_backfill/raw_payloads/. The only writer of that directory, src/w2/ingestion/independent_signal_backfill.py:write_raw_artifact, stores {endpoint, captured_at, payload} with the provider payload unchanged and adds none of those markers. Repository-wide, the string CANONICAL_AH_FACT appears in src/ only at those two reader sites.

CanonicalHistoricalAhFactModel is written and read only within src/w2/historical/fah_repository.py. No factor, feature or prematch module reads canonical_historical_ah_facts, so its quote_captured_at never reaches a factor builder.

The table carries kickoff_utc and quote_captured_at only. quote_captured_at is a pre-match odds capture: src/w2/historical/formal_ah.py admits a source only when snapshot_semantics == 'CAPTURED_AT' and blocks CLOSING, AGGREGATE and DATE_ONLY. The settlement itself is derived locally by w2.domain.odds.settle_asian_handicap from the goals, so it becomes knowable when the result does -- a time the row does not record.

src/w2/tracking/outcome_ledger_repository.py:493 sets confirmed_at from _authoritative_result, which is the earliest RawPayloadModel.captured_at whose fixture status is terminal -- a genuine observation time. The same module at :792 sets confirmed_at = datetime.now(UTC), a materialisation clock. No column records which writer produced a row, so the column alone proves no observation semantic. The order forbids assuming one.
